children.description: Content rendered inside the panel (React component or element)

className.description: Class to add to outer div

hasNoBorder.description: Flag to remove the panel's border

isAutoHeight.description: When used with a scrollable panel, sets the panel to auto height

isFullHeight.description: Flag to make the panel fill the available height of its container

isGlass.description: Modifies the panel to use glass styling when the glass theme is enabled

isPill.description: Uses pill (fully rounded) border radius for the panel

isScrollable.description: Flag to add scrollable styling to the panel
